subject.title: Feishu: bot does not respond when @-mentioned in a reply message

question: Should maintainers adopt or repair the open fork candidate, or close it and queue a fresh narrow target-repo Feishu fix for this issue?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and still present, but the only exact candidate is outside the target repo, conflicting, and inherits the old branch's unsafe orphan-placeholder and root-clearing shape.

options.title: Replace With A Fresh Narrow Fix
options.body: Use the old PRs as context but implement the fix against current main with bot-specific dropped-mention evidence and scoped routing tests.

options.title: Adopt And Repair The Fork PR
options.body: Ask the fork PR author or a maintainer to rebase and rework the existing branch until it preserves mention-gating and topic/session routing invariants.

options.title: Defer Feishu Reply Work
options.body: Leave this as an open known Feishu bug until a channel owner has bandwidth, without starting another automated repair lane.

recommendation.title: Replace With A Fresh Narrow Fix
recommendation.body: Use the old PRs as context but implement the fix against current main with bot-specific dropped-mention evidence and scoped routing tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Feishu mention handling work makes this the closest routing candidate for deciding the safe dropped-mention detection shape.
